source: RobotContainer.java and the subsystems it calls, robot code main 1ae9dacd (2026-10-10)

controllers.name: Driver gamepad
controllers.summary: Drives the robot and runs the intake, indexer and shooter.

bindings.label: Drive
bindings.action: Moves the robot field-relative: push up to drive away from the driver. The push is squared for fine control, with a 10 % dead band.

bindings.label: Turn
bindings.action: Left and right turn the robot, up to 0.75 turn per second. Squared, with a 10 % dead band. Up and down do nothing.

bindings.label: Extend intake
bindings.action: Drives the intake out until it stops moving.

bindings.label: Shoot
bindings.action: Spins the flywheel up. While it is at speed, the conveyor, both kickers and the indexer roller feed balls into it.

bindings.label: Reverse rollers
bindings.action: Runs the intake roller and the indexer roller out, to clear a jam.

bindings.label: Reset pose
bindings.action: Sets the field pose to the origin with the heading for the alliance color.

notes: M1 and M2 copy other buttons through the Razer app, so the robot code cannot see them. This map shows them as not used.

controllers.name: Joystick
controllers.summary: Plugged in on port 1. Nothing is bound to it yet.
notes: The code declares m_joystick on port 1 but binds nothing to it yet.
